subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: rabindranath tagore is my favourite author he was born at jorasanko in kolkata on the 7th may 1861 my brother loves him very much Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Punctuation and capitalization: Rabindranath Tagore is my favourite author. He was born at Jorasanko in Kolkata on the 7th May, 1861. My brother loves him very much. ●Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
